regions.name: National
regions.where: All of El Salvador (no regional titles or locator map)
regions.notes: 1st Rainy Season shading runs mid-May to mid-Jul; Second Rainy Season mid-Aug to mid-Nov (gap = canícula, not labelled). Lean box mid-Apr to mid-Aug. Primera harvest mid-Aug to end-Sep. Postrera harvest bar covers Dec and continues as the unlabelled Jan bar (one season, wrapping). Primera planting is all of June; Postrera planting mid-Aug to end-Sep. Agricultural labour (cash crops Oct-Feb; maize/beans) and hurricane season (Jun-Nov) rows not transcribed.

assign.method: Single national calendar with no regional titles or locator map; every adm1 mapped to national.

transcriber_notes: Edges drawn at mid-month are counted (at-least-half rule); in El Salvador both rainy seasons, the lean box, Primera harvest and Postrera planting all start or end exactly at mid-month, so each of those spans is one month longer than a strict >50% reading. Land-preparation label 'Postera' is a typo for Postrera on the image.
